 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Kawhi Leonard and the Toronto Raptors will face off against Chris Finch and the Minnesota Timberwolves on Sunday as the 2026-27 NBA regular season begins.
 Minnesota general manager Matt Lloyd made new changes for the 2026-27 NBA regular season. The Wolves got rid of forward Julian Randle and acquired LaMelo Ball from the Charlotte Hornets.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For Toronto, the offseason was mired in controversy with the acquisition of forward Kawhi Leonard from the Los Angeles Clippers. Owner Steve Ballmer was fined and banned from all league and team activities for an entire year, although the Raptors were able to keep Leonard.
 Raptors vs Wolves TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 Los Angeles Clippers forward Kawhi Leonard (2).Gary A. Vasquez-Imagn Images
 Time: 7 p.m. ET
 Venue: Target Center, Minneapolis
 TV: NBATV, DAZN MIN, DirecTV
 Live stream: YouTube TV, Sling TV
 Both teams are undefeated at the start of the season. Toronto is coming off a 112-102 win over the Washington Wizards on Friday. Forward Scottie Barnes finished with a team-high 28 points and 14 rebounds, while Leonard finished with 16 points and nine rebounds.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Minnesota is coming off a 115-93 win over Paolo Banchero and the Orlando Magic on Friday. All five starters for the Timberwolves scored in double figures, with forward Jaden McDaniels and guard Anthony Edwards tying for a team-high 15 points. Guard LaMelo Ball put up 12 points in 23 minutes.
 Atlanta was swept by Toronto during the 2025-26 NBA regular season. Both teams finished with identical 46-36 records, giving the Raptors the tiebreaker and a higher seed in the 2026 NBA Eastern Conference playoffs.
